name: remuxing-to-mov
description: Lossless-first remux of broadcast captures (.ts, .mpg/.vob, .mkv, broken .mov) into verified, QuickTime-ready .mov — plus a source clinic that checks and corrects a capture in its own container without remuxing at all. Never re-encodes video, never touches the source; every output is verified, and every codec/container claim is re-measured on a named bench (history in CHANGELOG.md).
